gen-dafont-redux-gf-radio-canada: Redux spreads wide, geometric letters with a generous swoop into every curve, while Radio Canada keeps its lowercase c, s and z tall and full. Pure poise.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-ruda: Big sweeping entrances into each curve mark Redux, with a wide, enlarged lowercase. And Ruda follows in a wire-thin monoline sans-serif, its diagonals as thick as its uprights.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-sarpanch: Sarpanch reads approachable and compact, its e wide open and its lowercase close to the ascender line. Redux, the display heading, arrives with wide spacing and moderate stroke contrast, which is where the pair gets its pull.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-savate: Contemporary and clean, Savate sets sturdy hairlines and open curves. Redux is the showier one, spacing its geometric heading wide with a visible entrance into each curve, while Savate quietly keeps a tall, rounded o.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Approachable is the first word for Schibsted Grotesk, whose e and a carry tall bowls and terminals that never close in. Schibsted Grotesk keeps low contrast down the page, so Redux's wide, geometric heading stays the only flourish.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-sofia-sans: Stencil-cut and wide-set. Redux heads the pair with tame contrast and wide spacing, and Sofia Sans follows in rounded, tall lowercase with no thick-and-thin modulation and clearly open sides.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-sofia-sans-semi-cond: Wide-set heading, signage-plain body, side by side. Redux gives each curve a big visible entrance and a restrained thick and thin, while Sofia Sans Semi Condensed holds a constant, stencil-cut line with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stack Sans Notch is clean and rod-straight throughout. Redux brings a faint nib-pressure swell to its wide, geometric rounds, and that gap between a pen-touched heading and a single constant stroke width is the pair's whole charm.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-stack-sans-text: That generous, visible entrance into every curve is what sets Redux apart, wide-spaced and mellowly modulated. And Stack Sans Text carries on in a marker-like line, big lowercase with curve endings kept well apart, steady down a full page.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-tiktok-sans: Wide, geometric and a bit theatrical. Redux brings a mild thick-and-thin rhythm to the heading, and TikTok Sans answers with low contrast and an x-height rising close to cap height, which is the pair's clearest difference.
